content:
"The search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, an Indian tourist who vanished after a pavement collapse in Kuala Lumpur on 23 August, has been suspended due to extreme danger. She fell into an 8-metre-deep sinkhole and has not been located; only her slippers have been recovered. Authorities have said the operation entered its eighth day without success.

Efforts have included tracker dogs, remote cameras, and ground‑penetrating radar, plus flushing sections of underground drains with high‑pressure water jets and clearing debris with excavators. Despite these measures, no conclusive trace has been found.

Officials stated the safety and health of personnel are paramount. A minister in the prime minister’s department, Dr Zaliha Mustafa, confirmed that sending divers further is too risky after an earlier attempt had to be aborted.

* Key facts: the collapse occurred on 23 August; depth is about 8 metres; two divers withdrew due to hazards; a prior soil slip was reported at the same spot last year; the operation is paused for safety.

Is there anything else I can help with?"
